title: dOPT: Differentiating Conic Optimization via Geometric Reduction
summary: Optimization layers enable the incorporation of structured constraints and decision problems into learning systems. Training such systems requires differentiating through the embedded optimization problem, which can be challenging for general conic programs. We introduce dOPT, a solver-agnostic framework that, rather than differentiating the full conic formulation, reduces it at a computed primal-dual solution to an equality-constrained quadratic program that preserves the reference solution and its first-order sensitivity.
